name: Software Quality Assurance Records (SQAR) Review Checklist
origin: Authored by Unical from DO-178C Section 11.19 content, Annex A objectives and Unical IV&V practice

items.question: The cover page carries the data-item title, the system / LRU name, the software item name and the platform.
items.expected_evidence: Cover page with full title and identification of the system, LRU and software.
items.reference: Unical IV&V practice / CEMILAC template front matter
items.guidance: Check that the title states the data item (e.g. 'Software Design Description') and the product it covers.

items.question: A unique document number is shown on the cover and in every page header or footer.
items.expected_evidence: Document number on the cover and repeated on each page.
items.guidance: The number must match the number quoted in the SCI and in companion documents.

items.question: Issue / revision and issue date are stated and agree between the cover, the header and the revision history.
items.expected_evidence: Issue or version identifier and date on the cover and in the revision history.
items.guidance: Look for conflicting versions (e.g. 'Rev 01' in the header but 'v1.0' on the cover).

items.question: The software level (DAL) of the software item is declared.
items.expected_evidence: Explicit statement of the software level in the identification block or introduction.
items.guidance: The DAL must agree with the PSAC.

items.question: The signatory block identifies the author, reviewer and approver with name, designation and date.
items.expected_evidence: Prepared / reviewed / approved block with names and roles.
items.guidance: IV&V must not be shown as approver of the applicant's document unless the plans give IV&V that authority.

items.question: A revision history records every issue with date, change description and affected sections.
items.expected_evidence: Revision / amendment history table.
items.guidance: Check the front matter and identification against the authority template. Record exactly what is on the page (quote it) and where.

items.question: A table of contents is provided and matches the section headings and page numbers.
items.expected_evidence: Table of contents.
items.guidance: Check the front matter and identification against the authority template. Record exactly what is on the page (quote it) and where.

items.question: All acronyms and abbreviations used are defined.
items.expected_evidence: Acronyms / abbreviations list.
items.guidance: Check the front matter and identification against the authority template. Record exactly what is on the page (quote it) and where.

items.question: Applicable and reference documents are listed with document number, title and issue.
items.expected_evidence: Reference documents table including plans, standards and system data.
items.guidance: Every document cited in the text should appear in the list and vice-versa.

items.question: Every page carries page numbering in the form 'Page x of y' (or equivalent) and the document identification.
items.expected_evidence: Consistent header / footer with page numbering.
items.guidance: Check the front matter and identification against the authority template. Record exactly what is on the page (quote it) and where.

items.question: No unresolved placeholders remain (TBD, TBC, 'XX', 'Error! Reference source not found', empty fields).
items.expected_evidence: Document free of placeholders, or each TBD tracked with an owner and closure date.
items.guidance: Open TBDs are acceptable only where the plans allow them and they are tracked.

items.question: SQA records include review and audit reports, meeting minutes, authorised process deviations and conformity review records.
items.expected_evidence: SQA record set.
items.guidance: Locate the clause required by the template / DO-178 Section 11 for this data item. 'Present' means the content exists with enough detail to be used; a heading with no content is Partially Compliant.

items.group: 3.1 DO-178C Annex A objectives supported by the SQAR
items.question: Assurance is obtained that software plans and standards are developed and reviewed for compliance with this document and for consistency. - the SQAR provides the evidence this objective needs at the declared level. Independence required at level(s) A, B, C.
items.expected_evidence: Content in the SQAR that substantiates A-9 objective 1 (DO-178C 8.1.a).
items.guidance: Confirm the document provides what the DO-178 objective needs at the declared level. Missing evidence in this document is not proof that the activity was not done - say what is missing and where it should be.

items.group: 3.1 DO-178C Annex A objectives supported by the SQAR
items.question: Assurance is obtained that software life cycle processes comply with approved software plans. - the SQAR provides the evidence this objective needs at the declared level. Independence required at level(s) A, B, C, D.
items.expected_evidence: Content in the SQAR that substantiates A-9 objective 2 (DO-178C 8.1.b).
items.guidance: Confirm the document provides what the DO-178 objective needs at the declared level. Missing evidence in this document is not proof that the activity was not done - say what is missing and where it should be.

items.group: 3.1 DO-178C Annex A objectives supported by the SQAR
items.question: Assurance is obtained that software life cycle processes comply with approved software standards. - the SQAR provides the evidence this objective needs at the declared level. Independence required at level(s) A, B, C.
items.expected_evidence: Content in the SQAR that substantiates A-9 objective 3 (DO-178C 8.1.b).
items.guidance: Confirm the document provides what the DO-178 objective needs at the declared level. Missing evidence in this document is not proof that the activity was not done - say what is missing and where it should be.

items.group: 3.1 DO-178C Annex A objectives supported by the SQAR
items.question: Assurance is obtained that transition criteria for the software life cycle processes are satisfied. - the SQAR provides the evidence this objective needs at the declared level. Independence required at level(s) A, B, C.
items.expected_evidence: Content in the SQAR that substantiates A-9 objective 4 (DO-178C 8.1.c).
items.guidance: Confirm the document provides what the DO-178 objective needs at the declared level. Missing evidence in this document is not proof that the activity was not done - say what is missing and where it should be.

items.group: 3.1 DO-178C Annex A objectives supported by the SQAR
items.question: Assurance is obtained that software conformity review is conducted. - the SQAR provides the evidence this objective needs at the declared level. Independence required at level(s) A, B, C, D.
items.expected_evidence: Content in the SQAR that substantiates A-9 objective 5 (DO-178C 8.1.d).
items.guidance: Confirm the document provides what the DO-178 objective needs at the declared level. Missing evidence in this document is not proof that the activity was not done - say what is missing and where it should be.

items.question: Differences from the PSAC are identified and justified.
items.expected_evidence: Difference statements.
items.guidance: Compare identifiers, versions, roles, tools and statements with the companion documents. If a companion document was not supplied, record 'could not verify' rather than a non-compliance.

items.question: Identifiers and versions match the SCI.
items.expected_evidence: Matching versions.
items.guidance: Compare identifiers, versions, roles, tools and statements with the companion documents. If a companion document was not supplied, record 'could not verify' rather than a non-compliance.

items.question: Statements are supported by SCM and SQA records.
items.expected_evidence: Record references.
items.guidance: Compare identifiers, versions, roles, tools and statements with the companion documents. If a companion document was not supplied, record 'could not verify' rather than a non-compliance.

items.question: The document uses committal language ('shall', 'will') for required activities rather than 'may' or 'should'.
items.expected_evidence: Committal statements for every required activity.
items.guidance: Non-committal wording in plans and standards cannot be audited.

items.question: Every activity identifies who performs it, what record is produced and when it is performed.
items.expected_evidence: Role, record and timing stated for each activity.
items.guidance: Judge whether an auditor could check compliance from the text: committal language, named roles, records and timing, consistent terminology.

items.question: The text describes the project's own practice and is not copied verbatim from DO-178C.
items.expected_evidence: Project-specific description of methods.
items.guidance: Verbatim copying of DO-178C text is a common reason for authority findings.

items.question: Terminology is consistent throughout and with the companion documents.
items.expected_evidence: Same names for items, roles and processes throughout.
items.guidance: Judge whether an auditor could check compliance from the text: committal language, named roles, records and timing, consistent terminology.

items.question: Figures and tables are numbered, titled and referenced in the text.
items.expected_evidence: Numbered and captioned figures and tables.
items.guidance: Judge whether an auditor could check compliance from the text: committal language, named roles, records and timing, consistent terminology.

items.question: Records show assurance that plans and standards were developed and reviewed for compliance and consistency.
items.expected_evidence: Plan/standard review records.
items.guidance: Judge the engineering depth: is the content specific to this product and sufficient for the declared level, or generic text that cannot be verified?

items.question: Records show assurance that life cycle processes complied with approved plans and standards.
items.expected_evidence: Process audit records.
items.guidance: Judge the engineering depth: is the content specific to this product and sufficient for the declared level, or generic text that cannot be verified?

items.question: Records show transition criteria were satisfied.
items.expected_evidence: Transition audit records.
items.guidance: Judge the engineering depth: is the content specific to this product and sufficient for the declared level, or generic text that cannot be verified?

items.question: The software conformity review was conducted and its record is complete.
items.expected_evidence: Conformity review record.
items.guidance: Judge the engineering depth: is the content specific to this product and sufficient for the declared level, or generic text that cannot be verified?

items.question: SQA records show SQA independence from development.
items.expected_evidence: Independence evidence.
items.guidance: Judge the engineering depth: is the content specific to this product and sufficient for the declared level, or generic text that cannot be verified?
